title: CCRS: A Zero-Shot LLM-as-a-Judge Framework for Comprehensive RAG Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and validating technical metrics (Contextual Coherence, Question Relevance, Information Density, Answer Correctness, and Information Recall) for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, specifically using a biomedical dataset. It does not address religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
